title: A New Chapter of the Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought he had seen through everything, a voice that transcended time and space exploded in his Mental Sea—that was the whisper of the Heavenly Eye: 'You have finally reached this point, chess piece. All threads will converge in the next chapter.'

text.content:
When the warm Jade Pendant fell into his palm, Chen Ji suddenly realized—he had not just received Ye Qing's token, but her complete trust entrusted with her life. The Demonic Path's kill order might arrive tonight.

He kept the Jade Pendant close to his body, feeling the faint warmth seep through the fabric into his skin. This was Ye Qing's hidden piece in the Holy Sect, the chip she had traded for ten years of undercover work, yet she handed it to him without hesitation.

"Ye Qing..." Chen Ji murmured the name, his fingertips tracing the patterns on the Jade Pendant. It was a Manjusaka flower, the legendary flower that blooms on the shore of the Yellow Springs—its leaves and flowers never meet, yet they entrust each other with life and death.

He silently pledged in his heart: this trust, he Chen Ji would never betray.

The exit of the secret realm was just ahead, a faint light membrane separating the inner and outer worlds. Chen Ji took a deep breath, feeling the surging spiritual energy within him—it was a sign of imminent breakthrough.

Three months ago, he had entered this place at the peak of Foundation Building. Now, after countless trials of life and death, his foundation had been consolidated to the extreme.

"It's time." Chen Ji sat cross-legged, and the Tianji Record slowly unfolded its third page within his divine consciousness. As golden light flickered, an arcane force flooded into his Mental Sea—the power of causal retrospection, allowing him to see the causes and effects behind any matter.

With a thunderous roar, spiritual energy surged like a tide. The bottleneck of mid Golden Core stage shattered in that moment.

dialogue.content:
"Congratulations on entering mid Golden Core, and even more gratifying—the power of causal retrospection has formed." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the Tianji Record, and a faint smile actually appeared on that blurred face. "At this moment, you can trace the origin of causality of a matter, rather than merely foresee the next three hours."

Chen Ji opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the flowing golden light. He looked up at Mo Xiansheng: "This power... is there a price?"

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, the remnant soul trembling slightly as if weighing his words.

"Causal retrospection... each use consumes three times the Heavenly Fate value of foresight." He paused. "But it has one advantage that foresight does not—you can actively choose the target of retrospection, rather than passively waiting for images to appear. This means you can actively seek answers, instead of being led by fate."

Chen Ji nodded, carving this information into his Mental Sea. Fifteen points of Heavenly Fate per use was indeed a heavy price. But compared to passive waiting, taking the initiative was his style.

"One more thing." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became grave. "The awakening of your causal retrospection power has alarmed something that should not have been alarmed."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji frowned slightly: "What thing?"

"The Heavenly Eye." When Mo Xiansheng said these four words, the remnant soul actually stepped back involuntarily. "The awakening of each generation of Tianji Record holders would attract its attention. But usually... after the seventh awakening. And you, you alarmed it on the third."

Chen Ji's heart sank. He remembered the preview of Volume 8—Chen Ji only realized in Volume 8 the terrifying truth that he had been watched all along. Could it be starting now?

"What will it do?" Chen Ji asked, his voice terrifyingly calm.

"I don't know." Mo Xiansheng shook his head. "But one thing is certain—it won't let you die easily. You are the inheritor of the Tianji Record, an important chess piece it has placed in the world. It will only... continue to lay out its game."

text.content:
Chess piece.

Again, a chess piece.

Chen Ji slowly stood up, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth. From Chen Xuan to him, the inheritors of the Tianji Record had been manipulated generation after generation, their fate controlled by an invisible hand.

But he, Chen Ji, was never a person willing to be a chess piece.

"Since I am a chess piece, let's make this game more interesting." He murmured, his gaze piercing through the light membrane of the secret realm, as if he could see through the essence of this heaven and earth.

"Three months." Chen Ji clenched his fist, feeling the power of mid Golden Core stage surging within him. "It's time to go out. Ling Yuan, Chen Nian, and the so-called Heavenly Eye... it's time to settle our accounts."

dialogue.content:
The light membrane slowly dissipated before Chen Ji, and the long-lost daylight poured in. The moment he stepped out of the secret realm, a familiar aura rushed toward him—it was Ling Yuan.

That seemingly kind old sect master was standing not far outside the secret realm at this moment, with Xuanwu Sect's first genius Han Lie beside him. The two seemed to have been waiting for a long time.

"Chen Ji, you're finally out." Ling Yuan's voice was as gentle as ever, but Chen Ji detected something like... scrutiny within it.

"What机缘did you obtain in the secret realm?" Han Lie spoke directly, not hiding his greed in the slightest. The spiritual energy fluctuation behind him was subtly suppressing the surrounding space—that was the pressure of Nascent Soul stage, even more terrifying than three months ago.

Chen Ji sneered in his heart: Perfect timing. He was worried about not having an opportunity to probe Ling Yuan's depths.

choice.prompt: Facing the combined pressure from Ling Yuan and Han Lie, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: "Retreat to advance, show weakness to the end."
choices.description: "Continue maintaining thetrashpersona, pretending you gained no机缘in the secret realm, letting them lower their guard while secretly observing their true intentions."
choices.visible_cost: "Temporarily give up the opportunity to display strength."
choices.visible_reward: "Further consolidate thetrashimage, letting enemies underestimate your threat level."
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan's depths are profound, he might see through your disguise."

text.content:
Chen Ji revealed a bitter smile, lowering his head as he said: "机缘? This disciple is dull and incompetent, merely surviving in the secret realm. Those heavenly treasures and spiritual herbs, this disciple didn't even dare to look at..."

His tone was extremely humble, even coordinated with a slightly trembling physique. Han Lie coldly laughed, obvious disdain flickering in his eyes. But Chen Ji noticed that in Ling Yuan's eyes there was a hint of... amusement?

"Is that so?" Ling Yuan walked closer slowly, his withered hand resting on Chen Ji's shoulder, a gentle yet unfathomable spiritual energy quietly invading. "Then let this old man examine your cultivation... Hmm, mid Golden Core stage? Three months' time, breaking through two minor realms—this cannot be explained by 'dullness.'"

Chen Ji's heart tightened—Ling Yuan was indeed testing him.

choices.description: "Release the mid Golden Core stage pressure, letting Han Lie feel the pressure, while hinting you obtained some kind of inheritance, observing Ling Yuan's reaction."
choices.visible_cost: "Expose partial trump cards, making Ling Yuan even more vigilant."
choices.visible_reward: "Let Han Lie suffer a public setback, raising your status in the sect."
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan might accelerate his layout against you as a result."

text.content:
Chen Ji no longer held back, his entire aura suddenly released. The mid Golden Core stage pressure surged forth like a tide, colliding head-on with Han Lie's Nascent Soul stage pressure.

Han Lie's expression slightly changed—three months ago thistrashhad been sent flying by one palm from him, yet now he could actually contend with him?

"You—!" Han Lie stared at Chen Ji in disbelief, his fists clenched so hard they cracked.

But Ling Yuan only smiled faintly, and in those cloudy old eyes, a sharp glint flashed: "Good, good, good. It seems Chen Xuan's inheritance has finally awakened."

Chen Ji's heart sank: As expected, Ling Yuan knew the existence of the Tianji Record from the beginning. His 'kindness' was merely a disguise waiting for this moment.

choices.description: "Secretly consume 15 points of Heavenly Fate to retrospect Ling Yuan's true thoughts at this moment, see through the chess game he has set up, while seeking countermeasures."
choices.visible_cost: "Consume 15 points of Heavenly Fate, weakening Chen Ji's life destiny foundation."
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence: Ling Yuan's bloodline secret, Chen Nian's location clue, and the method to remove the Heavenly Fate Shackles
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption will attract further attention from the Eyes of Heavenly Dao

text.content:
Chen Ji quietly activated the power of the third page of the Tianji Record. The karma tracing force, like invisible threads, pierced through the river of time, presenting Ling Yuan's present karma origin before his eyes.

The scene flowed rapidly—

He saw Ling Yuan kneeling before Chen Xuan, his eyes filled with fanaticism: 'Master, I am willing to sacrifice my bloodline, only to gain the Tianji Record's recognition!'

He saw Chen Xuan shake his head and pass the inheritance to another person—a young man named Chen Xuan.

He saw the fanaticism in Ling Yuan's eyes transform into a wave of boundless hatred in that moment.

Finally, he saw the figure of a woman—Chen Nian! Imprisoned by chains in a place of absolute darkness, blood at the corner of her mouth, yet still raising her head stubbornly.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his fingernails digging deep into his palms. Found. His sister's location, he had found her!

The karma tracing images gradually dissolved in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, but that information had already been deeply carved into his divine soul.

Ling Yuan—no, he should be called Ling Yuan·Chen. He was originally Chen Xuan's disciple, wanting to obtain the Tianji Record's inheritance at the cost of his bloodline, but was rejected by Chen Xuan.

He hated Chen Xuan even more for choosing someone else. So he changed his name and concealed his identity, lurking in the Tianqing Sect, waiting for his chance. And now, he had waited long enough—the inheritor of the Tianji Record stood right before him.

'Interesting.' Chen Ji sneered in his heart, 'A rejected candidate who played the role of a kind elder for decades before me. Such patience is indeed admirable.'

But what concerned him even more was Chen Nian's location. According to the karma tracing results, she was imprisoned in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds—a place adjacent to Chen Xuan's ruins. There, the key to removing the Heavenly Fate Shackles lay hidden.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan walked slowly toward Chen Ji, those turbid old eyes now shining with astonishing brightness.

'Chen Ji, Chen Ji, do you know why this old man has always "protected" you?' His voice was no longer gentle but carried a madness suppressed for decades, 'Because you are the key. The key to opening Chen Xuan's legacy, the key to the complete version of the Tianji Record.'

He reached out, his withered fingertips pointing directly at Chen Ji's brow center: 'Hand over the Tianji Record, and this old man can let you die more comfortably. Your sister... oh, you already know where she is, don't you? She is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the perfect candidate to open Chen Xuan's ruins. Once this old man obtains everything of Chen Xuan, you siblings can reunite.'

Chen Ji coldly stared at him, a mocking arc curving at the corner of his mouth: 'Reunite? Are you planning to reunite us on the Yellow Springs Road?'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan has shown his cards—how should Chen Ji counterattack?

choices.description: Expose Ling Yuan's true identity and his betrayal from years ago before Han Lie, causing the Xuanwu Sect and Tianqing Sect to turn against each other, while damaging Ling Yuan's prestige.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger a sect war prematurely
choices.visible_reward: Completely dismantle Ling Yuan's decades-long carefully cultivated image, destroying him completely before the world
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may have backup plans, and Han Lie may not believe you

text.content:
Chen Ji burst into laughter, the sound filled with mockery.

'Senior Ling Yuan, or should I call you Ling Yuan·Chen? Back then, you tried to obtain the Tianji Record inheritance by sacrificing your bloodline. After being rejected by Chen Xuan, you harbored resentment, changed your name, and lurked in the Tianqing Sect for decades—such patience, one truly "admires" it.'

Ling Yuan's expression changed drastically.

'How... how do you know this?'

'How do I know?' Chen Ji snorted derisively, 'Brother Han Lie, your Xuanwu Sect formed an alliance with the Tianqing Sect—but do you know your ally is actually the descendant of a traitor? Hatred for the Chen Xuan bloodline flows in his veins. Do you think he would genuinely help you?'

Han Lie's expression turned gloomy as he stared at Ling Yuan, the trust in his eyes already wavering. Ling Yuan gritted his teeth: 'You whelp, don't you dare sow discord!'

choices.text: Reveal the third page of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Activate the karma tracing force, projecting Ling Yuan's past karma origin into the air, letting everyone see his former betrayal.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 points of Heavenly Fate and partially expose the Tianji Record's abilities

text.content:
Chen Ji spoke no more nonsense. The Tianji Record unfurled dramatically behind him.

In the dazzling golden light, a scene slowly emerged in mid-air—a young man kneeling before Chen Xuan, tearfully begging for the inheritance, only to be rejected by Chen Xuan shaking his head.

'Master! I am willing to sacrifice my bloodline, only to obtain the Tianji Record!'

'Your heart is crooked. You are unworthy of bearing this.'

The scene shifted—the young man's fanaticism had transformed into boundless hatred as he left, vowing one day to make Chen Xuan pay the price.

Ling Yuan's expression completely changed. Han Lie stared in disbelief, the shock and fury evident in the Xuanwu Sect's top talent's eyes.

'Ling Yuan! You deceived us!'

choices.text: Stall for time, secretly contact Ye Qing
choices.description: Use the Demonic Path Saintess token to secretly contact Ye Qing, letting her Demonic Path mist shroud this area's aura, creating a假象 of Demonic Path invasion, and escape in the chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Prematurely expose the alliance with Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Safely escape while making the Tianqing Sect and Xuanwu Sect believe they were attacked by the Demonic Path, thereby transferring the conflict
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's location may be exposed as a result, and she will face the Holy Sect's pursuit

text.content:
Chen Ji quietly crushed the Jade Pendant in his palm, and a familiar aura pierced through the void.

The next moment, black mist surged from all directions, shrouding the entire area. Demonic Path Mist!

'The Demonic Path attacks!' Han Lie exclaimed, instinctively activating his spiritual energy for protection.

Ling Yuan's expression changed dramatically: 'This is... the手段 of the Holy Demonic Sect! Chen Ji, you have ties to the Demonic Path!'

'Whether I do or not, does Senior think that matters?' Chen Ji's voice came from within the mist, carrying mockery, 'Compared to thistrash having ties to the Demonic Path, the betrayal of this 'righteous ally' of yours seems far more noteworthy, doesn't it?'

As the mist gradually dissipated, Chen Ji had already vanished from where he stood. In the distance, Ye Qing's figure flickered in and out of sight.

'You should go.' she said, 'The situation ahead is more complicated than you imagine.'

Chen Ji walked shoulder to shoulder with Ye Qing, passing through layers of mist to arrive at a secluded valley.

'You went too far.' Ye Qing's voice was somewhat hoarse, 'Ling Yuan will not let this go, and the Xuanwu Sect will regard you as a traitor.'

'So what?' Chen Ji smiled indifferently, 'I never cared about such虚名. I only know that Ling Yuan covets my sister, Chen Nian is trapped in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds—and that place is also the entrance to Chen Xuan's ruins.'

He stopped walking and turned to look at Ye Qing: 'The prophecy I showed you three months ago is about to come true. The Demonic Path Commander's invasion, the internal turmoil of the three major sects, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land—all threads will converge at Chen Xuan's ruins.'

Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then softly said: 'Are you certain about this? Entering Chen Xuan's ruins means confronting the Eyes of Heavenly Dao directly.'

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not answer, merely raising his head to gaze at the sky.

There, something was watching him.

Not Ling Yuan, not Han Lie, not any existence he knew. But a force far more ancient, far more terrifying, surpassing everything in his认知.

"I know." Chen Ji said softly, his voice terrifyingly calm, "From the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, I knew I was being watched. The Heavenly Eye... it regards me as a chess piece."

He turned to look at Ye Qing, his eyes gleaming with a certain resolve: "But it made one mistake—it doesn't know that a chess piece can also devour the chess master."

The moment his words fell, an invisible force pierced through the void, flooding into Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

It was the voice of the Heavenly Eye—ancient, majestic, irresistible:

"You finally understand. Then, the game officially begins."

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his eyes becoming unfathomably deep in that instant, as if capable of seeing through the karmic connections of all things in the world.

"Game?" He coldly laughed, "You have set up your scheme for ten thousand years, playing with prophets of every generation. But you forgot one thing—"

He raised his hand, pointing at his own chest: "The Tianji Record chose me, not because I am a chess piece. But because I have the qualifications to become the one who holds the pieces."

The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a moment, then emitted a meaningful laugh:

"Interesting. Then let this old man see how far this chess piece of yours can go."

The voice dissipated, and the oppression in his Mental Sea faded with it. But Chen Ji knew, this was only the beginning.

"Three-month countdown ends." He murmured, turning to look into the distance—that direction, where Chen Xuan's ruins lay, "The final battle... begins."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing stood quietly at Chen Ji's side, gazing at his resolute profile, an indescribable emotion surging in her heart.

"What do we do next?" she asked.

Chen Ji took out a yellowed map from his bosom—the one Mo Xiansheng had given him, marking the location of Chen Xuan's ruins and the method to enter them.

"First, the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds." He said, "Rescue Chen Nian, find a way to break the Heavenly Fate Shackles. Then, using Chen Xuan's ruins as the chessboard, play a grand game against the Heavenly Eye."

Ye Qing took the map, gazing at the intricate routes drawn on it, suddenly smiled: "Do you know what this means? It means we're making enemies of the entire Demonic Path Holy Sect."

"Not us." Chen Ji corrected, a cold glint flickering in his eyes, "It's them. The Holy Sect's Sect Master has already been controlled by the Heavenly Eye. He thinks he is the chess master, but he's merely another chess piece."

He turned to look at Ye Qing, his gaze softening slightly: "And you, no longer need to be controlled by it."

text.content:
Ye Qing was stunned. She looked at Chen Ji, at the light in his eyes that seemed capable of seeing through everything, and suddenly felt her eyes grow hot.

Ten years.

For ten years, she had been used as a tool by the Holy Sect, as a chess piece by the Heavenly Eye, struggling aimlessly in darkness. And now, someone told her—she could no longer be controlled.

"Chen Ji..."

"No need to say more." Chen Ji interrupted her, taking an elixir from his sleeve and handing it to her, "This was refined by me in the secret realm. It can temporarily suppress the Demonic Seed corrosion in your body. Take it before entering the Holy Sect."

Ye Qing took the elixir, her fingertips brushing against his cold palm, and somewhere in her heart, a piece of hard ice quietly melted.

"Then when do we depart?"

Chen Ji gazed into the distance, where dark clouds gathered and thunder rumbled. A smile curved his lips:

"Now."

The moment Chen Ji was about to take his first step, the Tianji Record suddenly unfolded on its own, its third page blazing with golden light.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying an unprecedented gravity:

"Chen Ji, before you step into Chen Xuan's ruins, there are things you must know."

"What things?"

"The Heavenly Eye's layout is far deeper than you imagined." Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled slightly, "It is not merely manipulating you; it is manipulating the entire world. Three thousand years ago, Chen Xuan fought against it, sealing the Heavenly Eye. But the seal is loosening—and the Tianji Record fragment in your hands is the core of the seal."

Chen Ji's footsteps halted: "So..."

"So, the Heavenly Eye needs you. What it wants is not destruction, but control. It intends to use you to complete the repair of the seal—then, completely integrate the Tianji Record into its own system."

Chen Ji closed his eyes, absorbing this information. After a moment, he opened them again, his gaze calm:

"Then let its careful calculations be in vain."

choices.text: Rescue Chen Nian first, stabilize the rear

text.content:
Chen Ji brought Ye Qing, infiltrating the Holy Sect's territory. Following the routes on the map, they avoided layers of guards and arrived at the perimeter of the Forbidden Grounds.

"It's here." He gazed at that pitch-black tower, complex emotions flickering in his eyes. His sister was inside, imprisoned for who knows how many years.

"Let me go in first to scout—" Ye Qing was about to speak when Chen Ji stopped her.

"No need." Chen Ji said, taking out the Tianji Record from his bosom, "I have a better way."

He channeled his Spiritual Energy, and the power of the Tianji Record's third page activated once more. Karmic Retrospection—this time, he traced how to open this Forbidden Grounds' gate.

Scenes flew by rapidly, and a familiar scene appeared—it was Ling Yuan! He held a key in his hand, conversing with the guards of the Forbidden Grounds.

"So that's how it is..." Chen Ji coldly laughed, "Ling Yuan, as expected, you're involved too."

choices.text: Enter the ruins first, seize the initiative
choices.description: Without waiting to rescue Chen Nian, directly enter Chen Xuan's ruins to search for clues to break the Heavenly Fate Shackles. Get ahead and obtain the treasures within the ruins, adding leverage for the final battle.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian continues to be imprisoned and may be threatened by Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the powerful legacy left by Chen Xuan, further enhancing strength; may find methods to counter the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Without Chen Nian, this 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key', certain prohibitions within the ruins may be impossible to解除

text.content:
The entrance to Chen Xuan's ruins was hidden within a nameless mountain range, utterly impossible for ordinary people to discover.

Chen Ji stood before the cliff face, channeling the Tianji Record. A beam of golden light shot from his fingertip, striking the rock face. Amidst rumbling sounds, an ancient stone door slowly revealed itself.

"Chen Xuan's ruins..." Ye Qing gazed at that stone door emanating a vast and primordial aura, a flicker of reverence in her eyes, "Legend has it that the greatest secrets of ancient times lie buried here."

"Not buried." Chen Ji said, "Inherited."

He pushed open the stone door, a whiff of primordial energy rushing to meet them. Beyond the door was a long corridor, with murals on both sides depicting the origin of the Tianji Record—

That was a great battle of ancient times. The gods and Buddhas of the heavens fell, the Heavenly Way collapsed, and one person stood forth, using the Tianji Record as a medium to reestablish the world's rules.

"That person was Chen Xuan." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, carrying a trace of nostalgia, "And also your... past life."

choices.text: Contact Su Qingyao, form a three-way alliance
choices.description: Through a special channel, contact Su Qingyao and share intelligence about the internal affairs of the Tianqing Sect, persuading her to join forces against Ling Yuan, forming a rebellious faction within the Tianqing Sect.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the alliance between Chen Ji and Ye Qing, possibly causing Su Qingyao's misunderstanding
choices.visible_reward: Gain support from Inner Disciples of the Tianqing Sect, gaining a favorable position in the sect war; Su Qingyao's favor greatly increases
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may not be able to accept cooperation with the Demonic Path, requiring more explanation

text.content:
Chen Ji transmitted information to Su Qingyao through a token within the Tianji Record.

In less than an hour, Su Qingyao appeared at the designated location. She maintained that cold and aloof demeanor as always, but in her eyes when looking at Chen Ji, there was an added layer of complex emotions.

"Chen Ji, do you know what you're doing?" Her voice was somewhat hoarse, "Consorting with the Demonic Path, exposing your identity, making enemies of Ling Yuan—are you trying to destroy the entire Tianqing Sect?"

"Quite the opposite." Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes, "I am saving it. Ling Yuan is a traitor, he sold the Tianqing Sect's secrets only to exchange for Chen Xuan's legacy. And I, shall stop it before the Heavenly Eye destroys everything."

Su Qingyao fell silent. After a moment, she took a deep breath: "...I need evidence."

Chen Ji projected the karmic retrospection images into the air, allowing Su Qingyao to witness Ling Yuan's betrayal with her own eyes.

Su Qingyao's expression grew increasingly grim. When she saw Ling Yuan kneeling before Chen Xuan, pleading for the legacy, and then saw the insane hatred in his eyes as he departed, her hands had already tightly clenched into fists.

"Master he... actually..."

"Don't you understand yet?" Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable power, "Lingu Yuan's 'protection' of the Tianqing Sect was merely to await this moment. What he wants is Chen Xuan's legacy, is the Tianji Record, is power surpassing everything. As for the Tianqing Sect's survival, it has never been within his considerations."

Su Qingyao closed her eyes, her shoulders trembling slightly. After a long while, she opened her eyes again, the confusion within them having transformed into resolve:

"Tell me, what do you need me to do?"

Chen Ji, Ye Qing, Su Qingyao—three people who seemed impossible to join forces, now stood on the same side.

"Next, there are three things to do." Chen Ji drew a simple map on the ground. "First, rescue Chen Nian. She is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the key to opening the deepest part of Chen Xuan's ruins. Second, find a way to break the Heavenly Fate Shackles. Without this, even if I enter the ruins, I cannot confront the Heavenly Dao Eye directly. Third—"

He raised his head, his gaze sweeping over the two: "Deal with Ling Yuan. He is the Heavenly Dao Eye's agent in the mortal world, and our greatest obstacle."

Ye Qing nodded: "I have the defensive layout maps of the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds."

Su Qingyao said in a low voice: "I know the internal situation of the Tianqing Sect best."

A smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth: "Then let's begin."

Just then, a sound that transcended time and space suddenly erupted in the Mental Sea of the three—

"All the chess pieces are in position. The game officially begins."

It was the voice of the Heavenly Dao Eye, carrying an irresistible pressure, and also a hint of playful amusement.

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his gaze seemingly piercing through the endless Void to meet those unseen eyes.

"Bring it on," he said quietly. "This game, I'll see it through to the end."
